d: Bihar ki rajdhani patna sthit kangres pradesh mukhyalay sadakat aashram men patrakaron ke sath huee marpit aur badasluki ki ghatna par bihar sarkar ke mantri vijay sinha ka bayan samne aaya hai. midiya se batchit karte hue mantri vijay sinha ne kangres karyalay men patrakaron ke sath huee hinsa par tikhi pratikriya vyakt ki hai.
